sentences.text:
THE TAHSILDAR, GADIVEMULA MANDAL, GADIVEMULA,
 NANDYALA DISTRICT, ANDHRA PRADESH  ...RESPONDENT(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased topleased

For the reasons stated in the accompanying affidavit, it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass an order or direction or Writ, more specifically one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring proceedings bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03-2021, passed by the Sub-Collector Nandyal , i.e., Respondent Number 3 in rejecting the payment of compensation for lands of the petitioner resumed for public purpose on par with payment of Rs 5.50 Lakhs per acre as paid to patta holders and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the honourable High Court of Andhra Pr'adesh in Mekala Pandu case and and as confirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No 7904-7912 dated 04- 08-2014 and consequently direct payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner of Ac 5.00 Cents of land in survey No. 728/B2 of gani village,
gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District, AP duly duly setting aside the orders bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03-2021  2 Shahjah Bee vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115725153/
1 insofar as the petitioner is concerned with all applicable consequential benefits including interest from the date of taking possession on 03-03- 2015 and pass such other order or further orders as are deemed fit and proper in the circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice.

Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.
